ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B3-1, Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 28-E in the area bound by:

a line 49 feet south of and parallel to East 119" Place; South Michigan Avenue; a
line 73 feet north of and parallel to East 119'" Place; and the alley next west of
and parallel to South Michigan Avenue;

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

EE jt burke

Anthény Beale
Alderman, 9° Ward

Common Address:
11938 S. Michigan Avenue
